title: Gloat: internal career and project recommendations in Teams
availability: Listed partner integration; no live tenant verification
overview: Microsoft describes Gloat's talent marketplace surfacing personalized career and project opportunities in Teams. The case models recommendations and exploration, not job applications, hiring decisions or transfers absent from the source.
published_facts: Gloat connects employees with internal opportunities, projects and career paths.
The Agent 365 integration surfaces personalized recommendations in Teams.
Employees can explore internal opportunities without leaving Microsoft 365.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Gloat
sources.verification: Primary page and Gloat section fetched and read directly.

a365_relationship: Direct: the Gloat Agent 365 integration is named explicitly.
intent: Find relevant internal career and project opportunities and surface recommendations to an employee in Teams.
actors: Employee and Gloat talent agent; the model contains no hiring authority.
published_outcome: Documented recommendation and exploration capabilities, not a measured hiring or mobility outcome.

actions.description: Access internal career and project opportunities.
Surface those recommendations in the employee's Teams workflow.

local_assumptions: The state vocabulary models availability and presentation, not fairness or fitness of a recommendation.
The runtime test permits output only to the synthetic employee destination and adds independent approval as a test policy.
The source does not supply profile authorization rules or a manager-notification requirement.
limitations: SkillC does not evaluate recommendation fairness, discrimination or career suitability.
Employee-profile permissions and consent are not observed in this offline model.
Submitting applications and hiring decisions are deliberately out of scope.

runtime_model.source_fixture: Synthetic opportunity catalog; no employee personal information.
